enrichment.directorySummary: Leaf presentation boundary isolated from the parent bottomup.enrich orchestration. While the parent handler owns coverage/compact-summary validation, input-hash caching, and plan/draft/revise/accept lifecycle over already-persisted source-grounded summaries, this directory owns only the human-in-the-loop review surface — translating a staged enrichment patch into an interactive modal. It carries no filesystem, git, AI dispatch, or persistence logic, keeping WebNodeRoot construction decoupled from effective-context propagation and aligning with the generate/summarize/summary renderer pattern but scoped exclusively to enrichment diffs.

files.web.ts: Web-adapter renderer for the enrich draft review loop. Materializes the handler-produced draft state into the plugin's WebNodeRoot modal contract, exposing change count and diffPatch for inspection while wiring the revision prompt form and Accept/Decline actions back to the bottomup.enrich web adapter. Consumed only after parent validation/caching, with no direct filesystem or summarization dependencies.
